blocks.label: Match, robot and alliance
blocks.note: Scout name, match number, robot number and alliance. Every report needs these.

blocks.label: Did the robot show up to the field?
Preload
blocks.note: Whether the robot started with a preload.

blocks.label: Starting position
blocks.help: Your alliance wall is on the left. Highlights indicate starting lanes, not exact robot locations.
blocks.note: Which of the five starting lanes the robot used.

blocks.label: Estimated points scored
blocks.help: Drag to estimate, or type an exact number, a range such as 40-60, or a lower bound such as 100+. Optional.

blocks.label: Where did the robot collect fuel?
blocks.help: Select every location observed during autonomous.

blocks.label: Observed roles
blocks.help: Select every role this robot meaningfully performed.
blocks.note: Scorer, Defense or Shuttler. Used by Power Rankings.

blocks.label: Balls scored
blocks.help: Pick a suggested range from the list or type a number, a range or a lower bound, like 137, 100-150 or 500+.
blocks.note: The scoring estimate every analytics page uses.

blocks.label: Defense details
blocks.note: Appears when Defense is picked: robots defended, hub active/inactive, shifts and a 1-10 effectiveness.

blocks.label: Real-scout observations
blocks.note: Required when the robot played defense: the scout describes the defense.

blocks.label: Did the robot shuttle fuel?
blocks.help: Shuttling is moving fuel toward your alliance zone without scoring it, by driving it, pushing it or launching it.
blocks.note: Yes or no; the other shuttling questions appear only for yes.

blocks.label: Fuel shuttled
blocks.help: Pick a suggested range or type a number, a range or a lower bound, like 30, 25-50 or 100+.

blocks.label: Shuttling effectiveness
blocks.help: 1 is poor and 5 is excellent. Leave blank when you could not judge it.

blocks.label: Shot accuracy
blocks.help: Each number shows the band it stands for. Boundary values belong to the lower band.

blocks.label: Balls per second
blocks.note: A slider; its 1-5 band also fills the older BPS rating.
blocks.help: Drag to the robot's typical scoring rate while it was shooting.

blocks.label: Driver skill
blocks.help: 1 is poor and 5 is excellent: field awareness, control and decision making.

blocks.label: Power ranking
blocks.help: Tap the robots from best to worst in this match. Mark a robot "Didn't watch" to leave it out; every scout's rankings are averaged per match.
blocks.note: Averaged across scouts on Power Rankings.

blocks.label: Robot status
blocks.note: Active, dead or stopped for each shift (1-4) and endgame.
blocks.help: One answer for every shift and the endgame.

blocks.label: Significant crash
blocks.note: Whether the robot crashed, and into what.

blocks.label: Fouls
blocks.help: Count the fouls called on this robot. Leave at — if you could not tell.
blocks.note: Any foul asks for its nature from a dropdown.

blocks.label: Mechanical break
blocks.note: Needed to decide whether the pit crew must be told.

blocks.label: What broke and how the team handled it
blocks.help: What broke, how it changed the robot's play, and how the team played around it or fixed it.
blocks.note: What broke is required when there was a mechanical break.

blocks.label: Send a problem to the pit crew
blocks.note: Hides only the optional checkbox. When a robot dies or breaks, the required pit problem report still appears.
